comparison_basis: Executable source and deterministic synthetic acceptance; not a human-time study.

engineering_phase.ambiguous_environment_manual_decisions: 5-7 across the 16-environment synthetic benchmark; decisions are never auto-authorized.
engineering_phase.review_artifact_for_unique_mapping: One explicit, proposal-digest-bound decision file; this does not establish server permission.

frozen_baseline.interpretation: The baseline exposes no executable live discovery, review-materialization, or MCP investigation command. Manual source-configuration time and step count are not reconstructable from that interface.

qualification_boundary: Synthetic-only. Simulated review and permissions do not establish company authorization, data semantics, or transfer rights.

synthetic_validation.end_to_end_investigation: Both variants complete official-SDK discovery, deterministic source mapping, digest-bound synthetic review, bounded MCP reads, and B01/B02/B03/B05 evidence analysis. The second variant also completes the CLI workflow.
